name: Search entries
description: Export media entries filtered by tag, owner, category, and UTC creation dates.
notes: Uses core media.list, without the reference script's optional bulk-export jobs. Narrow the date window if the query reaches Kaltura's 10,000-match boundary.

name: Count & duration report
description: Export media entry details and summarize entry count and duration for a filtered date range.
notes: This is an inventory calculation, so ANALYTICS_BASE is unnecessary. Optional source-filename URLs and flavor-size reporting are omitted to avoid download access. Dates are UTC; use multiple date windows for large collections.

name: Audit captions
description: List captions, labels, languages, and formats for explicit entry IDs; record entries with no captions.
notes: Explicit CSV targets avoid account-wide discovery. CAPTION_SEARCH follows this project's scoped caption-read precedent; account-specific grants must be verified by the operator. No caption editing or deletion permission.

name: Download captions
description: Download caption files for explicit entry IDs, without modifying Kaltura content.
notes: Original files only; no caption creation, conversion, or category-descendant discovery. getUrl access must be verified on the target account; the runner stops on denial and never expands permissions.

name: Download original media
description: Download ready original flavor files for explicit media entry IDs.
notes: Media source flavors only; excludes documents, thumbnails, recursive category queries, and external media. No ingestion or mutation permissions.

name: Rename entries
description: Change entry names from a reviewed CSV, checking the expected current name before each update.
notes: Updates only the name field. Kaltura's metadata permission covers other metadata fields too; the local action manifest does not narrow the server's entire metadata grant. No delete or ingestion permission.

name: Set caption visibility
description: Show or hide specified caption assets, checking each asset's entry ID and expected label first.
notes: The script only updates displayOnPlayer, but CAPTION_MODIFY also permits caption creation and deletion. This preset therefore appears in the delete-capable category. Kaltura does not expose a separate visibility-only permission in the consulted catalog.

name: Delete entries
description: Delete explicit entry IDs after checking their expected names and requiring typed terminal confirmation.
notes: No metadata-edit grant is needed just to delete. This version omits the reference script's XML export and threaded processing; it logs each attempt, stops on failure, and never automatically retries writes.
